resourceRelationshipID: An identifier for an instance of relationship between one resource (the subject) and another (dwc:relatedResource, the object). See also https://dwc.tdwg.org/terms/#dwc:resourceRelationshipID
resourceID: An identifier for the resource that is the subject of the relationship. See also https://dwc.tdwg.org/terms/#dwc:resourceID
relationshipOfResource: The relationship of the subject (identified by dwc:resourceID) to the object (identified by dwc:relatedResourceID). See also https://dwc.tdwg.org/terms/#dwc:relationshipOfResource
relationshipOfResourceID: An identifier for the relationship type (predicate) that connects the subject identified by dwc:resourceID to its object identified by dwc:relatedResourceID. See also https://dwc.tdwg.org/terms/#dwc:relationshipOfResourceID
relationshipAccordingTo: The source (person, organization, publication, reference) establishing the relationship between the two resources. See also https://dwc.tdwg.org/terms/#dwc:relationshipAccordingTo
relationshipEstablishedDate: he date-time on which the relationship between the two resources was established. See also https://dwc.tdwg.org/terms/#dwc:relationshipEstablishedDate
relationshipRemarks: Comments or notes about the relationship between the two resources. See also https://dwc.tdwg.org/terms/#dwc:relationshipRemarks

resourceRelationshipID: This is the OBJECT of the relationship.
resourceID: This is the SUBJECT of the relationship.
relationshipOfResource: The relationship connecting the subject (resourceID) and the object (resourceRelationshipID)
